pump machine hall.hero: a sludge belt through two pulsing presses, between a settling basin and a filter drum
pump machine hall.exemplar: E3M5 crusher line s44-52; E3M3 generator consoles; E3M6 tanks s410-417
relations: side by side on one line, each with a riser to the roof; lettered INTAKE and FILTER
the sludge line runs south of both tanks; lettered SLUDGE
channel 105: toggles the belt's three open stretches, which pan and drag only while on
channel 106: a starter sets both presses slamming for good, as E3M5's are
the lever hangs on the hazard strip at the alcove's end

foundry underpass.hero: a brick passage under the works from the yard to the avenue, ending at the barred mouth of a metro that was never finished
foundry underpass.exemplar: E1M2 s103-105 (the passage to the waiting hall); the owner's DNE3L6 for the metro beyond the bars

foundry loading alcove.hero: two iron-banded freight leaves part into recessed tracks to reveal a chain-lit loading alcove with shotgun shells

RAT DOGS.hero: a works canteen that sells rats: a hatch on the yard with rats steaming on a burning grill, RAT DOGS over it, stand-up tables inside and a freezer of carcasses behind
RAT DOGS.exemplar: E1M4 s167 (the grill), s170 (the kitchen), s171 (the sign RATDOGS); E1M2 s185/s257 (the buffet and its kitchen wall); E1M3 s305 (the freezer); E3M2 s258 (the butcher and his tools); study canteen-freezer-dining

St Gallow's nave.hero: a clerestory of stained glass over the aisle, the outside's lancets seen from within

St Gallow's crypt.hero: one closed stone sarcophagus under a gravestone slab, in a rubble vault hung with cobwebs and gold plaques, a line of powder barrels along its east wall
St Gallow's crypt.exemplar: E1M1 s150 (rubble 110, earth 270), its sarcophagus s1-3/27/28, plaques sprites 185-189, cobwebs 150-154

the Weaver's Cellars.hero: brood alcoves walled in silk, a cocoon in each, under a ceiling where the spiders and their mother hang upside down
the Weaver's Cellars.exemplar: E2M8 s52 (silk 1057 alcoves, cocoon 1061, victims 1059, mothers on the ceiling); CHORROR s414 (web fringe 1067/1068, ceiling spiders, the web 410 across the way in)

Stockyard Drain.hero: a tiled race of blood running north from the slaughterhouse pipe and carcass rack into the Foundry Main
Stockyard Drain.exemplar: E1M8 s389 (the River Ride's drag), s251 (blood pipes); TEDE1M4 s82 (wash-room tiles); E3M2 s258 (hung carcasses)

Stockyard sampling chamber.hero: a low iron sampling trolley runs across the blood to a lit valve alcove, with a call button on each dry berth
Stockyard sampling chamber.exemplar: #2WAYCAR s1 (rigid floor that carries its rider); E1M2 s34 and sprites 384–391 (track and wheels)

Settling Hall service lift.hero: a metal filter deck on the west quay that rises past the tanks to the gallery, with a work light and call button at each landing
Settling Hall service lift.exemplar: MACHINERY-LIFT s2/s14 and sprite 9 (fixed-roof floor lift and remote call)

the Rat King's Shrine.hero: a low pipe leading to candles around a knot of rats and a heart on a stepped stone altar
the Rat King's Shrine.exemplar: E1M5 s71 (candle recess); DWE1M5 s610 (candles and remains on stone); E1M4 s167 (rats on the grill)

Ghost Station.hero: a lit, tiled platform with empty benches and rails leading to a bricked-up tunnel under the pump landing
Ghost Station.exemplar: E1M2 platform s272 and covered track s264–266; E3M2 sprites 669–671 and #SPR22 for its service controls

Gravesend Station.hero: a green-banded carriage standing at a platform under a plank canopy, seen through a line of riveted columns
Gravesend Station.exemplar: E1M2 s271/s272/s34 (hall, platform, track); STATION s128 (the solid car, livery 1665); tunnel STATION s131-137; an enterable car is NOT built. DOOR-ROTATING s4 (fare turnstile)

saloon.hero: a dim bar room with a lit plank counter, stools along it and whiskey lettered on the wall
saloon.exemplar: E1M2 s278 (height, light); DWE3M1 sprites 539-547 (stools); soffit and back bar NOT yet built

Aldermack auditorium.hero: a tall house facing a curtained stage
Aldermack auditorium.exemplar: SCHOOL_ s154/s244, FORDTHEA s252 (height); the framed proscenium and raked seats NOT yet built

harbour.hero: a moored hull between two rock headlands, the sea running out to a skerry and the sky
harbour.exemplar: DWE3M4 s636-648 (bands, ring); DWE2M6 s931-940 (rock), s621-626 (piles)

arcade concourse.hero: a tall concourse of glazed shopfronts, and a service corridor with something behind its wall
arcade concourse.exemplar: E4M9 concourse; E6M1 shopfronts; E3M4 sprite 331
relations: channel 104: shot, it opens the wall behind it and three charges go off; the cache is a secret
